v1.73.5a (3 September 2025) |feed_title = 💉 Revive & Reload 🔫 |feed_color = Pink |previous_update = [[v1.72.0|Assassin Update]] |next_update = [[v1.74.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.73.0''' is the one hundred and twenty-fifth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 20th of August 2025. It reworked the [[Medic]] and refreshed the [[Turret]], as well as adding two new [[Mission Quests]]. This update encompassed seven versions, the main v1.73.0 (released 20 August 2025) and six minor updates, v1.73.1 (released 29 August 2025), v1.73.2 (released 20 August 2025), v1.73.3 (released 21 August 2025), v1.73.4 (released 25 August 2025), v1.73.5 (released 27 August 2025) and v1.73.5a (released 3 September 2025). ==Additions== ===Skins=== *{{Color|EventMission|Mermaid}} [[Medic]] *{{Color|EventMission|Jetski}} [[Turret]] ===Maps=== *[[Distant Shapes]] ([[PVP]]) *[[Legacy Gilded Path]] (Survival) *[[Opulent Remains]] ([[PVP]]) ===Miscellaneous=== *''The Little Medic'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] *''Raft Wars'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Medic]] reworked. **[[Medic]] is no longer capable of attacking enemies, now it only shields other towers. This provides them with buffs and an immunity to stuns. **''Cleansing'' ability replaced with ''Ubercharge''. Functionality changed from removing all stuns from towers to applying an additional buff to assigned towers and giving them all detections. **Now can overheal the base health without [[Skills]], as it has its own separate limit per '''Medic'''. **Updated tooltips. **Unlock cost increased from {{Coins|800}} to {{Coins|2,000}}. **Placement limit of 5 added. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|450}} to {{Money|500}}. ****Damage removed. ****Firerate removed. ****Max targets of 1 added. ****Shield recharge speed of 8 added. ****Overheal limit of 0 added. ****Tower selection cooldown of 0.5 added. ****[[Firerate Buff]] of 20% added. ****Lead detection removed. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|200}} to {{Money|300}}. ****Range decreased from +1 to +0. ****Max targets increased from +0 to +1. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|750}}. ****Range increased from +0 to +2. ****Max targets increased from +0 to +1. ****Healing decreased from +5 to +0. ****Overheal limit increased from +0 to +5. ****Shield recharge speed changed from 0 to 8 > 6. ****Hidden detection removed. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|800}} to {{Money|2,700}}. ****Range decreased from +3 to +1. ****Healing decreased from +0 to +5. ****Overheal limit increased from +0 to +5. ****Unlocks ''Ubercharge''. *****Replaces the former ''Cleansing'' ability. *****Grants a 20% [[Damage Buff]] and all detections. *****Lasts 7.5 seconds. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,750}} to
